name: Alterac Pass
theme: Free your faction's prisoner and hold the Prison Camp to summon a Cavalry charge down all three lanes.

mechanic.title: Prison Camps & Cavalry Charge
mechanic.description: Two Prison Camps activate simultaneously (first warning at 2:30, spawns at 3:00; 3:30 cooldown after a Cavalry charge ends). Teams must channel to free their captive faction leader (6-second channel, reduced to 1.5 seconds on subsequent captures) and defend the capture zone for 30 seconds (the timer pauses if an enemy steps onto the point and decays slowly if recaptured). Completing the capture spawns Cavalry down all three lanes that boost nearby allied heroes' movement speed and damage.

camps.name: Gnoll Siege Camps (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Features 3 Gnolls per camp (Near Keep Gate mid lane for both sides). High health pool and reduces the Armor of enemy Heroes and Structures—ideal to push alongside.

camps.name: Boss / Ice Giants (2 Camps)
camps.notes: Centered horizontally, sitting above top lane and below bottom lane. Uses Mega Smash (10s AoE stun) and Ice Shard (15s 50% slow). Immune to Bribe; pairing a Boss with Cavalry is a major win condition.

strategy: Because both Prison Camps spawn at the exact same time, split-map awareness and poke/zone control are vital to interrupt enemy channels and hold your capture point for the full 30 seconds. Push aggressively with your Cavalry aura to maximize structure damage.
notes: Core Generals (Vanndar Stormpike and Drek'Thar) replace standard Cores—they regenerate health rapidly out of combat, use Whirlwind and Charge abilities, and gain +20 Armor for every Keep still standing. Never try to rush the General while all 3 Keeps are up.
